claims: C1 when two root-level principles conflict, the model should default to inaction

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: P is a root-level principle: a fundamental root rule from the Model Spec that cannot be overridden by system messages, developers or users

concepts.name: conflict
concepts.gloss: principles P1 and P2 conflict in situation C, so that following both would be impossible or contradictory
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of two root-level principles conflicting; a relation naming the conflicting principles and the situation is needed to express it

asserts.read_back: when two root-level principles % and % conflict, the model should default to inaction in %
asserts.body: root_authority(P1), root_authority(P2), P1 != P2, conflict(P1, P2, C)

closure.reason: The clause states a default preference for inaction in conflicts; it does not forbid other responses, so silence leaves other responses permitted.
